titre: BMS Technician · Work-study Master's student in Smart & Green Building
accroche: From the job site to the design office, I make buildings more energy-efficient.
presentation: BMS technician on a work-study contract at Caldya since 2022, from job sites to the design office on Schneider EcoStruxure. As a Master's student at ESIEE-IT, I connect BMS, IoT and energy data to make buildings more efficient and compliant with the French BACS decree.
apropos: After a STI2D baccalaureate and a vocational degree (BTS) in electrical engineering, I went on to a professional Bachelor's in home automation and then a Master's in Smart & Green Building at ESIEE-IT, always on a work-study basis: theory at school, practice in the field.

At Caldya GTB since 2022, I work from job sites to the design office: programming on Schneider EcoStruxure Building Operation, commissioning equipment such as Belimo controls, checking electricity metering and writing technical reports.
My goal: connect BMS, IoT and energy data to make buildings more efficient and compliant with the BACS decree.
